method.construction: Reasoner(graph) wall time; graph loading outside timing
method.limitations: one process and uncontrolled workstation; no memory measurement or independent-run confidence interval
method.ordering: python first on even repetitions; native first on odd; same order for updates
method.query: fixed public queries; includes temporary probe reasoning where requested
method.update: Reasoner.update wall time including graph copy/recompile/maintenance; fresh original setup excluded
method.validation: complete witness-inclusive RDF graph isomorphism every pair; independent traversal/manifest and fresh rebuilds
method.warmup: one discarded validated public-Reasoner construction/query per backend per case
